result.summary: The street environment features sidewalks on both sides, but the walkway on the right is narrow and significantly obstructed by utility poles. While speed humps are present to manage vehicle speeds, the lack of a buffer between pedestrians and the roadway in a mixed-use area limits safety.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstructions
hazards.description: Multiple utility poles are located directly in the center of the narrow sidewalk on the right side of the image, forcing pedestrians to step into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right side is extremely narrow, providing insufficient space for two people to pass or for wheelchair users.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width on the right side to meet ADA standards and provide a safer walking environment.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles or move lines underground to clear the pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lane.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide but poorly maintained sidewalk adjacent to a building with a blank, inactive ground-floor frontage. The walkway is cluttered with debris and lacks basic safety features such as street lighting or a buffer from the roadway.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked, uneven, and degraded, creating significant tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground and midground of the walkway

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long, windowless wall at the street level reduces natural surveillance and creates a hostile pedestrian environment.
hazards.location_in_image: The brown ground-floor wall of the building

hazards.name: Walkway Obstructions
hazards.description: Debris and trash are scattered across the sidewalk, impeding clear movement.
hazards.location_in_image: Scattered across the sidewalk surface

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the concrete sidewalk to eliminate tripping hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during evening hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce vegetation to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the aesthetic environment.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide sidewalks but is dominated by a broad, unmarked roadway and an elevated rail structure. The absence of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at the intersection, along with visual obstructions from bridge pillars, creates significant safety risks.

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street encourages higher vehicle speeds and makes pedestrian crossings more dangerous.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, extending towards the background.

hazards.name: Absence of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing areas are visible at the intersection, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection under the blue bridge structure.

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: The large pillars supporting the elevated rail line can hide pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: The blue steel pillars supporting the elevated rail line.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style markings at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated signals to provide clear timing for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a severely degraded sidewalk with significant cracking and vegetation growth, lacking a clear curb for separation from the roadway. The streetscape is dominated by blank walls and fenced vacant lots, which reduces natural surveillance and creates a hostile walking environment.

hazards.name: Degraded Walkway Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is heavily cracked with significant weed growth, creating tripping hazards and making it difficult for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground walkway area

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Separation
hazards.description: There is no distinct vertical curb separating the pedestrian walkway from the vehicle travel and parking area, increasing the risk of vehicle encroachment.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge between the paved walkway and the asphalt roadway

hazards.name: Poor Natural Surveillance
hazards.description: The presence of a large blank wall and a fenced vacant lot creates a 'dead' street edge that may discourage walking due to perceived lack of safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Background structures and fencing

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and repave the pedestrian walkway to provide a smooth, accessible surface free of tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Curb Installation
interventions.description: Install a standard vertical curb to clearly define the pedestrian realm and prevent vehicles from parking on or encroaching into the walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during evening hours.
